title: 3beta11 Omnipod Eros Status not set to "no active pod" before activation
symptom: When activating a new Eros pod, the screen shows 'Setup in progress (waiting for pod activation)'. The activation and deactivation processes proceed without issue, but the status is not set to 'no active pod' before activation.
evidence_quote: The error appears to be the preferences file. The message was removed by downgrading to ver 2.8.2.1 and importing an older preference file that didn't have an active pod.
